untestable.Evaluation: evaluates rules from the SAP/SQL Server rule catalog against workloads the project runs; the testing project runs none
untestable.DeploymentsActuation: actuates a Workload Manager SAP deployment; the testing project has none

skip.ListDiscoveredprofiles: discovered profiles come from Workload Manager's service agent scanning the project; the agent doesn't exist until an evaluation or deployment runs, so the list answers NotFound for the agent
